name: Titan Company Ltd
title: Titan Company Ltd - 500114 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Titan Q4 FY26 demand strong (buyer growth back to 8% from flat), but margins under pressure from gold-price mix and Damas/Middle East losses; management gave a 15-20% 3-5 year CAGR but no FY27 guidance.

triggers.label: Buyer growth 8% vs flat
triggers.quote: what we have reported is 8% versus a flattish for the period prior to that

triggers.label: Margin down 10-20 bps on gold mix
triggers.quote: Some 10-20 basis point, we have been kind of losing.
triggers.highlight: 10-20 basis point, we have been kind of losing

triggers.label: 15-20% growth held as 3-5 yr CAGR
triggers.quote: the 15% to 20% is something that we ought to do

guidance.quote: we believe 15% to 20%, three to five-year kind of horizon is certainly to be delivered on a CAGR basis

red_flags.label: Jewellery EBIT margin compression on gold mix
red_flags.quote: But beyond a point, there will be impact on margin, and that is visible.

red_flags.label: Middle East/Damas loss ₹82 crore in Q4
red_flags.quote: all those things have kind of come in the Q4 in the form of loss of ₹82 crores

evasions.quote: So, I would not give you a good assurance that this is sustainable.
We are not giving any guidance to you for FY27.
